title: FREE REQUEST Looking for Artist/Artists and Music Composer for my Game/project

posts.author: Vajko41
posts.body:
Hey everyone! i'm looking for help with my new project and perhaps future projects. I am looking for:
Pixel Artists - for Tilesets and sprites
'non' pixel artists too - for characters (ex: sprites when talking with characters)
Music composer
i'll be doing everything else but if you want to you could help with mapping and events.
contact me on @itanimulliteam.bsky.social Bluesky or here
I'm using RPG Maker MZ, this project is in short WLW Romance with some horror elements it is inspired by Fear and Hunger and a Anime Called "Strawberry Panic" and this one short little rpg maker game idk the name and can't find it.
Important: I'm looking for humans, please if you're AI 'Artist'/'Composer' ignore this thread.
